note: negative shift is a right shift
shift amounts 49 through 53 are valid when the result fits; Microsoft BITLSHIFT documentation
known difference: 1<<48 equals 2^48 which is out of Excel's 48-bit range (LibreOffice may return 2^48)
absolute shift amount 53 is allowed; Microsoft BITLSHIFT documentation
negative shift reverses direction at the allowed boundary; Microsoft BITLSHIFT documentation
absolute shift amount above 53 returns #NUM!; Microsoft BITLSHIFT documentation
